verdict.rationale: Highnote documents in-house KYC/KYB compliance handling, manual-review states triggering document collection, and a Document Upload SDK for identity verification, plus account-holder application approval flow before issuance. However, evidence lacks explicit documented data-field requirements for KYC/KYB, defined review-state taxonomy, or re-verification/periodic refresh flows. missing for 10: detailed data requirement schemas for KYC/KYB, explicit review-state lifecycle documentation, re-verification/periodic refresh process.
